title: Automatic Kaggle GPU assignment rejected for G2 qualification
summary: A CLI-launched GPU rerun was assigned a Tesla P100 instead of the required Kaggle T4 session. The notebook failed closed before numerical qualification because the device was not a T4 and its compute capability was incompatible with the installed PyTorch build.

resolution.required_gpu_workflow: User manually selects Kaggle GPU T4 x2; notebook accepts and records one or two visible T4 devices and executes on CUDA device 0.

prevention: Do not rely on the Kaggle CLI GPU toggle to obtain T4 hardware.
Fail closed unless every visible CUDA device is a T4.
Record accelerator topology in all future qualification receipts.
Keep numerical qualification on CUDA device 0 unless a separately reviewed multi-GPU contract is introduced.
